description.value:
Cheap, ugly, but effective. If you're given a choice between a Metel and nothing at all, it may seem like a tough decision, but the Metel is the right call. It's most popular in slums and amongst those who put their faith in their skills, not their hardware. It can inflict some serious damage in the right hands, so if you like challenges and have a fondness for junk, this revolver from Techtronika is for you.

Cost: 250eb (Premium)

Class: Poor Quality Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 8 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When firing Explosive Ammunition, this weapon is considered Excellent Quality, but still jams when rolling a Critical Failure (1) during the user’s Attack Check. Incompatible with Pistol Auto Sear.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
